snippet.title: Antonio & Anfiloquio Teaser
snippet.description:
While dealing with the loss of his wife, an old man goes into the dark to save his grandson...

Antonio & Anfiloquio is a slow first person horror with lots of visual novel DNA. A story about family secrets and rural mysticism.

Featuring:

Multiple endings
60 minutes average runtime
A haunting dark ambient soundtrack by ERASER
Grotesque digital artworks and frame-by-frame animations.
Text in English and Español.

#indiegame  #horror #horrorgaming
